Use of AI assistance

Source: AI_USAGE.md

This file discloses how generative AI is used in the development of trainingmodels. It is updated at each release.

  • Design decisions, scope and domain choices are made by the author (Jorge del Rosario Fernández Santos). They are recorded in DECISIONS.md.
  • Specifications and reviews are drafted with Claude (Anthropic) in chat.
  • Code is written by Claude Code from those specifications and reviewed by the author.
  • Every formula is verified against its cited source before implementation.
  • This file is updated at each release.
